additional_info.subject: RE: 0411527 - ID0411527-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP / P9 170000890] DC2 Transaction Stopped Unexpectedly After 3 Minutes CRM:02023000538
additional_info.body:
Dear Laurent Cosson,
I hope this message finds you well.
Could you kindly provide me with a summary of the timestamps for the charging sessions that were interrupted after 2-3 minutes? This will allow me to investigate further and get back to you with more details regarding the cause of the interruptions.
Regarding the cable temperature error, if the error is not cleared, the outlet status will be marked as faulted. If the outlet is available and the session continues to be interrupted, we will need to review the logs of the specific charging session to determine the root cause of the interruptions.
Additionally, I will review the data from the past 4 weeks related to the cable temperature error. If it has occurred multiple times, I will inform you of the next steps and coordinate with our regional service team for further troubleshooting.
Thank you for your assistance, and I look forward to your response.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
